description: List the collections visible in your space, newest first. Narrow with tag or search. Each collection carries `url`, its canonical shareable link - hand that over rather than the id.

offset.description: skip this many results for paging (0 = start)

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

tag.description: tag narrows the timeline to one tag (by name).

name: list_collections

author.description: author names the human who published it (created_by, resolved).

isExternal.description:
is_external is true when the origin space differs from the caller's
 viewing space (the collection was shared in from elsewhere).

openThreads.description:
open_threads and resolved_threads count the block-review threads on this
 collection: open = a status still owed (needs review / needs work / reject),
 resolved = done or approved. Populated by get_collection so an instance can
 tell whether a review is finished without reading the whole thing; 0 on
 responses from other calls.

originSpace.description:
origin_space names the workspace it was published from, when you belong to
 that workspace; empty otherwise, and is_external still says it came from
 elsewhere.

originSpaceId.description: origin_space_id is the space the collection was published from.

reviewRequested.description:
review_requested is true while the collection is under review (the
 approve/reject flow is on). Read it to tell whether you are looking at a
 collection that still expects a review decision.

title.description: title is what the collection is called.

url.description:
url is the canonical link to this collection (.../c/<id>) - the thing to hand
 to a person or paste into a message. It redirects through sign-in to the
 right space, so it works for anyone with access, from any device.

title: List collections
